notes: Lexicon for Sentiq's rule-assisted aspect analysis. 'terms' are matched on spaCy lemmas or lowercase tokens; 'phrases' are multi-word expressions matched on lemma or lowercase sequences; 'ambiguous_terms' only count when one of the listed context lemmas appears in the same sentence (otherwise they are reported as ambiguous candidates); 'exclude_phrases' suppress this aspect's matches that overlap them. Edit this file to change the taxonomy.

aspects.label: Teaching clarity & explanation
aspects.description: How clearly concepts are explained and how understandable the teaching is.
aspects.action_negative: Revisit how core concepts are explained: add worked examples, check understanding during class and summarise key points at the end of each session.
aspects.action_positive: Keep the current explanation approach and consider sharing it as good practice.

aspects.label: Subject knowledge
aspects.description: Perceived depth and accuracy of the instructor's subject expertise.
aspects.action_negative: Strengthen subject preparation for the weaker topics and invite questions that reveal gaps; consider co-teaching or guest sessions for specialised areas.
aspects.action_positive: Students value the instructor's subject expertise; continue linking it to advanced and current material.

aspects.label: Course content & organisation
aspects.description: Syllabus coverage, topic selection, and how well the course is structured.
aspects.action_negative: Publish a clear course outline with weekly topics and review whether the syllabus sequence and coverage match the learning outcomes.
aspects.action_positive: The course structure is working well for students; keep the outline and sequencing consistent.

aspects.label: Teaching methodology
aspects.description: Teaching methods, style and instructional approach.
aspects.action_negative: Diversify teaching methods (e.g. short activities, problem-solving, discussion) and gather quick mid-semester feedback on what helps students learn.
aspects.action_positive: Students respond well to the teaching approach; document it so it can be sustained across sections.

aspects.label: Student engagement & interaction
aspects.description: Interaction, motivation, rapport and how engaging classes are.
aspects.action_negative: Build more interaction into sessions (questions, pair work, quick polls) and make sure students feel comfortable asking questions.
aspects.action_positive: Classes are perceived as engaging and supportive; keep the interactive elements students mention.

aspects.label: Course materials & resources
aspects.description: Notes, slides, books, recordings and other learning resources.
aspects.action_negative: Share organised, up-to-date materials (slides, notes, references) before or soon after each class and check they match what is taught.
aspects.action_positive: Students find the learning resources useful; keep them updated and easy to access.

aspects.label: Assignments & workload
aspects.description: Homework, projects, deadlines and overall workload.
aspects.action_negative: Clarify assignment requirements and rubrics, spread deadlines across the term and review whether the workload is proportionate.
aspects.action_positive: Assignments are viewed positively; keep the current balance of workload and support.

aspects.label: Assessment & grading fairness
aspects.description: Exams, marking, grading transparency and fairness.
aspects.action_negative: Make marking criteria transparent (share rubrics and examples), return feedback promptly and review consistency of grading across students.
aspects.action_positive: Assessment is seen as fair and transparent; keep sharing criteria in advance.

aspects.label: Teaching pace
aspects.description: Speed of delivery and time management in class.
aspects.action_negative: Check the pace of delivery: pause for questions, use short recap points and move faster or slower on topics according to student understanding.
aspects.action_positive: Students are comfortable with the teaching pace; keep monitoring it for harder topics.

aspects.label: Availability & responsiveness
aspects.description: Punctuality, accessibility outside class and response to student queries.
aspects.action_negative: Set and communicate dependable office hours and response times, and keep class start times consistent.
aspects.action_positive: Students appreciate the instructor's availability; maintain clear office hours and response practices.

aspects.label: Practical relevance & examples
aspects.description: Real-world examples, labs, hands-on work and career relevance.
aspects.action_negative: Add real-world examples, lab or hands-on activities and explicit links between theory and practice or careers.
aspects.action_positive: Practical examples and real-world relevance are appreciated; keep connecting theory to applications.

aspects.label: Overall course experience
aspects.description: General evaluations of the course or instructor with no more specific aspect.
aspects.action_negative: Overall impressions are negative in several reviews; review the specific aspect findings above to identify where to start and discuss them with students.
aspects.action_positive: Overall impressions of the course are positive; consider which practices students mention most and keep them.
